hadith:
Apostates - Narrated `Aisha:

A group of Jews asked permission to visit the Prophet (and when they were admitted) they said, "As- Samu 'Alaika (Death be upon you)." I said (to them), "But death and the curse of Allah be upon you!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O `Aisha! Allah is kind and lenient and likes that one should be kind and lenient in all matters." I said, "Haven't you heard what they said?" He said, "I said (to them), 'Wa 'Alaikum (and upon you).
message: When we turn away from Allah's guidance, we risk spreading corruption and breaking our bonds with others, yet Allah meets us with kindness and gentleness—qualities He loves us to embody in return. Like the Prophet (peace be upon him) responded to hostility with compassion rather than harshness, we too can reflect An-Naafi' (The Bestower of Benefits) by choosing mercy in our interactions and seeking ways to benefit others rather than harm them. Let this inspire you to strengthen your ties of kinship, guard against corruption, and return to Allah's path with a gentle heart.
name:
An Naafi’ - النَّافِعُ - The Bestower of Benefits

The name An Naafi' highlights the divine attribute of providing benefits and positive outcomes to the believers and all of creation. It emphasizes God's mercy and generosity, reflecting His role as a source of sustenance and care for humanity and the universe.
verse:
Muhammad - Muhammad - 47:22

Now if you ˹hypocrites˺ turn away, perhaps you would then spread corruption throughout the land and sever your ˹ties of˺ kinship!
